content: The information provided here is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. Uses: Ceftolozane/tazobactam is a cephalosporin antibiotic used to treat various bacterial infections. How to Use: This medication is administered via injection into a vein as directed by your doctor, typically every 8 hours. It should be infused slowly over a period of 1 hour. The dosage is determined based on your medical condition and response to treatment. If you are using this medication at home, ensure you have been properly instructed by your healthcare provider on preparation and administration techniques. Before use, visually inspect the product for particles or discoloration. Do not use the liquid if either is present. For optimal effectiveness, administer this antibiotic at evenly spaced intervals. Continue using the medication for the full prescribed duration, even if symptoms resolve after a few days. Side Effects: Common side effects may include pain, redness, or irritation at the injection site, as well as nausea, diarrhea, or headache. Remember that this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Rarely, this medication may cause a severe intestinal condition due to the bacteria Clostridioides difficile (C. difficile). This condition can occur during treatment or weeks to months after treatment has stopped. Prolonged or repeated use of this medication may lead to oral thrush or a new yeast infection. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare. This is not a complete list of possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before using ceftolozane/tazobactam, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, cephalosporins, penicillins, or other antibiotics, or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other problems. This medication contains sodium. Ceftolozane/tazobactam may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines (e.g., typhoid vaccine). During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly needed. It is unknown if this medication passes into breast milk. Consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase your risk for serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use (including prescription/nonprescription drugs and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may interfere with certain lab tests (e.g., some urine glucose tests), potentially causing false test results. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Notes: While using this medication, lab and/or medical tests (e.g., complete blood count, kidney function) may be performed. Keep all medical and lab appointments. Missed Dose: It is important to receive each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately for a new dosing schedule. Storage: Consult the product instructions and your pharmacist for storage details. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed.
